content: Devid okhem ab'Ammọn
Okwu opyiri k'ogbe mẹ, ọvaarnọng kw'anọng p'Ammọn okwu opẹ, nnwa kwẹ kw'ijinọng kw'okpen Hanun ọn-ọdabh ẹvaar chẹ.

Iwa Devid oben bẹ bi, “Kaam ńsi ọphyaam nnang Hanun kw'ode nnwa kw'ijinọng kwa Nahash, mach'iwa otte osi ọphyaam ọnang-m.” Mẹ wọ, Devid ọtzọhm anọng bi bẹ atza adini Hanun nttem k'obo kw'otte. Mada atzọhmnọng pa Devid apyiri k'irerek s'Ammọn,

adenho p'Ammọn aben Hanun kw'ode itta kwabẹ bi, “Kọ achibhi bi ikpokpobha rọ sa Devid ọkhọk k'obo kw'atte yina ọtzọhm ajinọng mba bi, bẹ adin-ọ nttem o? Kwẹ mando kode e, ọtzọhmi bẹ bi, bẹ akwu arom obhon nwa, ifha oronga nden s'otzima orima obhon nwa abẹ o?”
Mẹ wọ, Hanun ọbọkha anọng mba pa Devid ọtzọhmi ophyiri agba-phyubha okhubha wani, obiro ọbọkha anọhma-baba pabẹ ọjaakhi m'awọriba, okhubh bẹ abhana.

Mada Devid ọbhaang odik nwa, ọtzọhm akkaabh-nkkaabha bi bẹ atza akhebha anọng mba, da bẹ akk'bẹ ọgbasadik-barada ananga. Ọvaarnọng on-oben bi, “Bọng wobha ka Jeriko maa agba-phyubha pabọng amen yina bọng akhuna.”

Mada anọng p'Ammọn an-are bi, bẹ akk'asa ettem epyibh Devid ttara bẹ, bẹ abher agbong-nọng p'Aram p'areng ka mmo nnọhna arọbh afa obhiri jobh, p'afon Bet-Rehob ọmaana Zoba. Wa ajinọng nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh jobh abira afona k'ọvaarnọng kwa Maaka, nnọhna ẹrọbh obhiri jobh afona Tob.
Mada Devid ọbhaang odik nwa, ọtzọhm Joab otzima agbong-nọng pẹ p'erima biphyir ọtza.

Wa agbong-nọng p'Ammọn ado igbong-for, atza atzobha kẹ da adimi k'ẹbaakhamma ch'odedenmon. Agbong-nọng p'Aram kwa Zoba ọmaana Rehob, ọmaana ajinọng pa Tob ttara pa Maaka, apaangi atzobha k'ettegweng ch'ẹbaang mẹ.
Mada Joab ore bi, bẹ akk'for ada s'egbong atzikh-ẹ k'itzitzikha ttara ka nnama-nnam, otzekha agbong-nọng akkakka p'Israẹl otzobha bẹ atza arima agbong-nọng p'Aram abẹ.
Wa ọtzọkha agbong-nọng mbongo p'arikhi otte ọbọhk ọnang ọgbaanọkka Abishayi kw'otzobh bẹ, otzima bẹ ọtza orima agbong-nọng p'Ammọn abẹ.
Joab oben bi, “Idikha anọng p'Aram agaangi kpọng ayọhng-m, kọ kwu kkaan-m o. Yina, idikha anọng p'Ammọn bẹ agaangi kpọng ayọhng-ọ, kaam ńkwu okwu ńkwu nkkaan-ọ.
Kọ gaangi for morima erima nda mach'akkakkaama ka nho s'anọng paman, ọmaana ka nho s'idedenmon s'Ibinọkpaabyi kwaman. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ósi-osi mach'ojibh-ẹ ka chen.”
Mẹ wọ, Joab ọmaana agbong-nọng pẹ afona atza arima anọng p'Aram abẹ, anọng p'Aram arọbh ma bẹ k'itzitzikha.
Mada anọng p'Ammọn are bi anọng p'Aram am-arọbhi, bẹ arọbh aji Abishayi adim k'odedenmon. Mẹ wọ, Joab ọkwọhbha anọng p'Ammọn abẹ oririma, ọkpa nnam ọbhana ka Jẹrusalẹm.
Mada agbong-nọng p'Aram an-are bi, agbong-nọng p'Israẹl akk'bẹ akhema, bẹ afona abira atza ado atzobha.
Wa Hadadẹzẹr ofona ọtza ọtzọkha agbong-nọng p'Aram k'Ọraanga okhubha kwa Yupharetes, bẹ akwu apyiri k'obhon kwa Helam. Wa Shobak kw'ode odenho kw'agbong-nọng pa Hadadẹzẹr, otzima bẹ eden.
Mada bẹ agbaakhi Devid odik nwa, otzobha anọng p'Israẹl biphyir, otzima bẹ ojekha Jọrdan ochina ka Helam. Wa anọng p'Aram abe k'adik p'egbong atzik Devid bi, ifha bẹ arim-ẹ abẹ.

Yina, aSiriya arọbh m'itzitzikha s'anọng p'Israẹl. Wa Devid ofhu ayaar-akpaar pa nnyanyaang mmindọr anọng ẹnọhna obhiri arọbh chi, ọmaana agbong-nọng p'areng k'irerek anọng nnọhna arọbh azen. Wa obiro obun Shobak kw'ode odenho kw'agbong-nọng pabẹ ofhu.

Mada avaar biphyir p'awobh k'irekh-irek kwa Hadadẹzẹr are bi, anọng p'Israẹl akk'bẹ akhema, bẹ afona atza asi ẹmẹm ttara anọng p'Israẹl, bẹ an-abira awobha k'irekh-irek kwabẹ. Mẹ wọ e, wa ojora osi anọng p'Aram bi, bẹ abira atza anang anọng p'Ammọn ẹkkaana.
